status: gas-state algebra, regional posterior sampler and common-grid reconstruction frozen before any regional spectral result, source-invariant score, lensing target, halo target or gravity parameter is opened
purpose: Convert future V19X3 temperature and APEC-normalization measurements into a common-grid gas-state posterior for the Bullet Cluster and Abell 2146 without hydrostatic equilibrium or lensing calibration.

algebra_correction.correct_surface_density: Sigma_gas = mu_e m_p sqrt((n_e/n_H) * EM_area * L)
algebra_correction.reason: Because n_e n_H = n_e^2/(n_e/n_H), the electron-to-hydrogen ratio multiplies rather than divides the recovered n_e squared.

physical_constants_and_composition.classification: measurement-conversion constants, not adjustable gravity parameters

geometry.reference_depth_rule: L_ref_kpc = sqrt(A_kpc2), the area-preserving geometric-mean sky-plane extent

posterior.ordered_profile_rule: draw temperature and normalization from their bounded asymmetric 68-percent profile-likelihood approximations and report dependence sensitivity
posterior.failed_profile_rule: retain a finite best fit and use the complete frozen fit-bound log-uniform prior for the parameter whose ordered interval failed; flag the region and do not narrow, merge, split, drop or selectively refit it
posterior.dependence_sensitivity: repeat with rank correlations -0.9, 0 and +0.9 between temperature and normalization when a joint likelihood surface is unavailable

common_grid.frame: cluster-centered east-positive and north-positive physical coordinates
common_grid.bin_label_resampling: nearest neighbor from the frozen V19M bin map so adaptive-region identity is not blended
common_grid.smoothing_rule: mask-normalized Gaussian smoothing; gas surface density is rescaled within the admitted mask to conserve its discrete integral exactly
common_grid.reason: common physical sampling and two predeclared derivative resolutions prevent native-pixel scale and adaptive-bin edges from selecting a source feature

front_state.shock_speed: upstream Mach number times upstream sound speed

claim_boundary: This preflight validates conversion algebra and frozen region geometry only; it is not a Sigma Gravity result.
Line-of-sight depth and profile dependence remain measurement nuisances and must not count as gravity constants.
The historical V19H formula error is corrected prospectively and is not hidden by rewriting a hashed parent.
A future gas map is a baryonic source reconstruction, not a dark-matter map and not a lensing-derived target.
Common-grid smoothing exposes 50 and 100 kpc source-resolution branches; neither may be chosen after viewing a lensing or halo target.

outputs.regional_products: one hash-bound NPZ per cluster and temperature-normalization dependence branch
outputs.common_grid_products: one hash-bound 241 by 241 summary-map NPZ per cluster and dependence branch
